items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Now and then, when Louis left, George Backett.

ctx.x: Yeah, now. Because I had my own, you see. Oh, I see. Well, who would be in Perez's band?
Well, he had, let me see, Jimmy Brown, Big Island, George Field, George Backett. Now and then, when Louis left, George Backett. And do you remember George Field?
I never knew him. He moved up to Chicago before my time. That's right.
